core_conclusion: Display the measured detection–false-alarm tradeoffs of the available RGB-T checkpoints, with training/checkpoint status explicit and no presupposed ranking.

evidence.source: Completed evaluation metrics.json files selected by active_results, or all recursive results when that field is absent.
evidence.operating_points: Plot the supplied threshold points without inserting, smoothing, averaging, fitting, or dropping zero-Fa observations. Straight segments only connect existing points in supplied order.
evidence.auc: Report the supplied AUC; do not normalize, extrapolate endpoints, or silently recompute it.
evidence.checkpoint_status: Distinguish released, final-training selected, and interim-training selected checkpoints.
evidence.statistics: Checkpoint-level descriptive metrics. No confidence intervals, significance tests, or seed-variability claims unless supplied separately.
evidence.missing_data: Missing, incomplete, invalid, or inactive results are listed explicitly and are never replaced by invented values.
evidence.protocol_comparison: Differences in target totals and reported protocol metadata remain visible in REPORT.txt and source CSVs.

visual_encoding.model_colors: One restrained color per model family, shared across both panels.
visual_encoding.legend: One shared legend below both panels; includes checkpoint status, selected epoch where available, variant, and AUC.

data: selected checkpoint hash matches when specified
qa.current_state: Contract and script prepared; actual render/visual QA requires real result files.
